name: average
title: Average - the everyday hardened PC
description: Minimum plus: the AI apps and the 'recommended' extra apps removed, more privacy settings, Defender network protection and attack-surface rules in AUDIT, all four old protocols off, UAC Always notify, Balanced app permissions, the Bluetooth network part off, Cloudflare time and DNS, the firewall log on and a component store cleanup. Windows updates stay as they are. Everything is recorded and can be undone in the Undo center.
